name: worldmap-module
description: Embeddable JavaScript widget that organizes arbitrary JSON data by country on an interactive world map.

scripts.build: npx --yes esbuild@0.25.10 src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --banner:js="/*! open-worldmap | MIT License | https://github.com/bogus-accnt/open-worldmap */" --outfile=dist/worldmap.js && npx --yes esbuild@0.25.10 src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --banner:js="/*! open-worldmap | MIT License | https://github.com/bogus-accnt/open-worldmap */" --outfile=dist/worldmap.min.js
